tasks.short: Help prepare research budgets and manage disbursement records

steps.what: Review actual study budget balances, commitments and recorded research expenditure
inputs: existing approved study budget
actual posted expenditure and committed orders
actual study activity records
outputs: checked current study financial position and gaps

steps.what: Develop proposed research budget assumptions with investigators and finance colleagues
inputs: checked current study financial position and gaps
actual proposed study activities and constraints
investigator and finance input
outputs: human-chosen activity, cost and timing assumptions

steps.what: Prepare the research budget worksheet using actual assumptions and approved cost rates
inputs: human-chosen activity, cost and timing assumptions
approved study cost rates and existing account codes
outputs: complete proposed research budget with calculated totals and explicit gaps

steps.what: Check and approve the completed budget worksheet as the coordinator's proposed version
inputs: complete proposed research budget with calculated totals and explicit gaps
human-chosen activity, cost and timing assumptions

steps.what: Save the approved coordinator budget proposal in the study finance workspace
inputs: approved final coordinator budget proposal
outputs: saved coordinator budget proposal awaiting authorised budget decision

steps.what: Prepare the actual research disbursement request and supporting study evidence for finance
inputs: actual invoice or permitted participant-payment request
verified study activity supporting the request
existing finance-verified payee reference and study account
approved payment rules
outputs: complete disbursement request with exact payee reference, amount, account, support and finance recipient

steps.what: Approve the completed disbursement request against actual supporting records and the verified payee reference
inputs: complete disbursement request with exact payee reference, amount, account, support and finance recipient
actual invoice or permitted participant-payment request
outputs: approved final coordinator disbursement request and finance recipient

steps.what: Send the exact approved disbursement request to the authorised internal finance recipient
inputs: approved final coordinator disbursement request and finance recipient

steps.what: Reconcile actual finance-reported disbursement outcomes against study requests and capture resolved status or discrepancies
inputs: finance-produced actual settled, rejected or pending payment references
submitted internal disbursement request
actual study finance records
outputs: complete actual disbursement reconciliation draft with unresolved discrepancies

steps.what: Approve the completed reconciliation record against actual finance outcomes
inputs: complete actual disbursement reconciliation draft with unresolved discrepancies
finance-produced actual settled, rejected or pending payment references

steps.what: Save the approved actual study disbursement reconciliation record
inputs: approved final actual reconciliation record

tasks.design: Configure actual budget views and payment-request fields in {ERP}, a validated budget worksheet in {SPREADSHEET}, and study reconciliation views in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The coordinator chooses assumptions with colleagues and verifies actual requests and outcomes; finance retains payment authorisation and execution in its own controlled process.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated budget figures, request fields and payment-status matching can surround the coordinator's research finance work.
tasks.enabler_now: Native budget reports, validated worksheets and reference-based payment matching can reuse actual finance records.
tasks.still_hard: Whether an expense is justified, a budget assumption is credible or a discrepancy needs escalation requires human judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The coordinator connects the study's actual activities to financial requests without treating a planned visit as completed work.

ambition.what: Review study affordability and unresolved payment discrepancies with current actual records.

reach.task: Authorise and execute monetary disbursements through its existing controlled process
reach.learn: Which actual outcome references can be returned without disclosing unnecessary payment details

build_days.consent_and_access: 2–5 for finance permissions, participant-payment privacy and site consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: finance systems can report budget balances, validate payment-request fields and match actual payment references to requests; spreadsheet templates can recalculate supplied budget assumptions.

assumptions: Shares and savings are provisional work-design arithmetic, not an observed finance baseline.

Actual expenditure, commitments and finance-verified payee references already exist. Missing payee setup or source records must be obtained through the authorised process and counted before using this scenario.
The coordinator captures chosen assumptions in s3 and actual request evidence in s6; only repeated fields, arithmetic and format validation are reduced.
Finance produces actual payment outcomes through its existing authorised work; no bank release is performed or saving claimed for that other role. Submission never means settlement.
s9 retains half its effort for exception judgement and capture of actual reconciliation results; native reference matching reduces only matched-item handling.
Configure native reports, request forms and matching first. Same-system saves and the short internal transmission receive no saving.
A coordinator-approved proposal is not an authorised budget increase. Required investigator and finance decisions retain their existing authority.
unknowns: Availability of reliable finance outcome references
research_questions: Which request fields can reuse verified data without inferring completed study activity?
How much reconciliation remains after native reference matching?

already_counted.description: Check exact disbursement request and recipient

incremental.description: Maintain budget templates, request-field mappings and reference-matching exceptions

approvals.approved_version: approved final coordinator budget proposal; changes return to s4
approved exact coordinator disbursement request, payee reference, amount, account and internal recipient; changes return to s7
approved final actual reconciliation record; changes return to s10

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 10 budget-view hours +6 worksheet hours +8 request-preparation hours +7 matched-reconciliation hours =31. Three upkeep hours give central net 28%; six additional hours resolving unmatched finance references give high 22%. Low zero if native configuration already covers the work or reliable actual references are absent. No bank-release or save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

reach: investigator: choose scientifically credible study activities
finance: authorise budgets, verify payees and execute actual payments
role.ambitious_version: A coordinator who can review study finances more often while keeping scientific assumptions, payment eligibility and actual finance outcomes explicit.
